title: Product Manager
description:
Role Objective / Major Purpose of the Job
  
  
The Product Manager will own end-to-end product lifecycle management for assigned brands, driving brand strategy, marketing execution, and performance monitoring. The role involves translating corporate and market objectives into actionable plans, supporting field teams, and ensuring successful product positioning, adoption, and growth.
  
  
Principal Tasks & Responsibilities
  
  

* Brand & Product Strategy

Develop and implement brand strategies in line with corporate objectives and therapeutic focus.
  
  
Define product positioning, messaging, and value proposition for target audiences.
  
  
Support forecasting, budgeting, and planning to achieve sales and marketing objectives.
  
  

* Marketing Program Execution

Plan and execute promotional campaigns, creative initiatives, and visual aids for field force engagement.
  
  
Ensure effective implementation of marketing programs including symposia, CME events, and KOL engagement initiatives.
  
  
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (Sales, Medical, Regulatory, Supply Chain) to ensure smooth execution of campaigns.
  
  

* Sales & Field Enablement

Provide training to sales teams on product USPs, brand strategy, and promotional campaigns.
  
  
Prepare presentations and marketing materials to support field activities.
  
  
Monitor field implementation to ensure adherence to brand plans and objectives.
  
  

* Market Research & Analysis

Conduct market research and competitive intelligence to inform product strategy.
  
  
Track brand performance metrics and analyze sales, prescription, and market trends.
  
  
Provide actionable insights to optimize marketing efforts and drive ROI.
  
  

* Financial & Performance Monitoring

Prepare and monitor Profit & Loss statements to track and control budgeted costs.
  
  
Ensure effective utilization of marketing budgets and resources.
  
  
Monitor key performance indicators and take corrective actions to meet targets.
  
  

* Customer & KOL Management

Support key customer development and CRM initiatives.
  
  
Facilitate engagement with KOLs to strengthen brand credibility and market penetration
  
  
Key Skills & Competencies
  
  
**Functional / Technical**
Strong product and therapeutic knowledge
  
  
Strategic brand planning and execution
  
  
Market research and competitor analysis
  
  
Data-driven decision-making and reporting
  
  
Cross-functional coordination and stakeholder management
  
  
Knowledge of pharma compliance and ethical marketing guidelines
  
  
Excellent communication and presentation skills

title: Technical Lead / Principal Engineer
description:
**The role**

We're hiring our technical lead to own the architecture and delivery of our unified product platform — bringing several mature in-house applications together into one cohesive, multi-tenant, cloud-hosted portal for external clients. You will set the technical direction, lead the existing development team, and be the person who takes this platform from internal tooling to a secure, scalable product that trading firms pay for.

This is a spearhead role. You'll report directly to the founders, shape the architecture from the ground up, and grow the team as the business scales.

**What you'll do**

* Own the end-to-end technical architecture for a multi-product, multi-tenant platform — frontend, containerised backends, shared services, and data isolation.
* Lead and mentor the existing engineering team; raise the bar on engineering practice, DevOps, and delivery.
* Design for commercial reality: client onboarding, security, auditability, and the realities of selling software to institutional buyers.
* Partner with the founders on the product roadmap and the build-to-revenue journey.
* Make the pragmatic calls — robust where it matters, lean where it doesn't — to ship on time without over-engineering.
* Streamlining processes using AI

**What you'll bring**

* 5–10+ years in software engineering, with real architectural ownership of a commercial product.
* Experience taking a B2B or SaaS product from build through to paying customers — you
  understand that
  how software is sold and shapes how it's built.
* Proven team leadership: you've led developers, set standards, and grown people.
* Strong foundations in cloud (AWS or equivalent), containerisation, multi-tenancy, and secure data handling.
* Comfort operating in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment with direct impact.

**Nice to have**

* Background in trading, capital markets, or financial technology is preferred
* Exposure to real-time data systems and performance at scale.

**Why this role**

You're not inheriting a legacy system or slotting into a layer of management. You're the founding technical voice of a company at the moment it goes to market — with a product already proven on live capital, an experienced team to lead, and the mandate to build it properly.

**Package**

Competitive salary, commensurate with experience.
